# Lantern parade: agreed brief

Agreed by the street committee on 20 October. The parade is on Friday 13 November.

Route and road:

- The parade walks 600 m from the school gate on Mill Lane to the recreation ground.
- The council has closed Mill Lane from 17:30 to 18:30 only. Nothing may stand in the road outside those hours.
- There are four road crossings on the route. Each has one steward in hi-vis. One more steward leads the parade and one walks at the back.

Evening:

- Lanterns are lit at the school gate at 17:45, and not before.
- The parade leaves the gate at 18:00 and reaches the recreation ground by 18:20.
- The choir sings two songs at the bandstand at 18:25.
- The hot chocolate stall opens at the pavilion at 18:30.
- The prize for the best lantern is given at 18:45.
- Everyone is off the field by 19:15, when the gates are locked.
